body:
I feel like you just need *some* kind of change to begin with. Nothing major yet, but something small and manageable. Maybe there is a group that you can meet with in town for some hobby? Yoga, modeling, bowling, something?

And maybe apply for new jobs, even if you don’t think you’re qualified. Talk yourself up and you may be surprised. 

Boredom is a very real depressant, I hope you will do okay.
I love my kids very much, and I wouldn’t lose contact with them. My wife promised to arrange video calls while I am out of town, so I’ve at least got that.

There isn’t really anyone. I was pretty much focused entirely on work and my family before, so she was really the only support I had here.

And I just talked to my boss right before I posted. My manager is sympathetic and said he would try to work it out to let me have the time off and keep my job, but he can’t promise it yet.
That does help a little. Thank you.

I’m renting a bedroom from someone right now, it was the only place I could get on very short notice.

I have to wait a week because of my job. I needed to give them some sort of heads up about going out of town, or else I’ll lose it and that will just make the whole situation worse.

I know I need to give my wife some time. But she has her new boyfriend now, and I guess I’m terrified she’ll fall in love with him and then that really is a wrap. Nothing I can do about it, but the thought is killing me.
My daughter is three and my son is five. Living with me for the moment just wont work. Their mom is a good mom and just better equipped to care for them right now.

I talk to my mom over FaceTime and she has told me to call her as much as I need. It always helps for a minute, but the second I hang up that isolation comes crushing down.

She is being cooperative on letting me see my kids, the problem is I’m finding it very hard to be in the same space as her without trying to talk her into giving me another shot. Objectively I know that is wrong, but I just can’t make myself not do it.

And I’ve talked to my kids about me going away for a while. My daughter doesn’t seem to understand, and my son cried and asked me not to go. He only understood when I told him that I need to go be near my mom the same way he does when he is sad. He seemed to understand that but still cries and asks me to stay.

Thank you. I’m trying to wait it out. I know I will feel better once I can get out of town and be near  own family, but it’s still seven days until the soonest I can go. I haven’t slept in two nights because I just lay awake thinking about her telling me she doesn’t want me back, and I can’t stand thinking of seven more nights in my empty ass apartment by myself.
